• Brand introduction:

Welcome to ElevenLabs, the award-winning health food company based in South Australia that is dedicated to providing you with easy and accessible nutrients that deliver real improvements. We understand that most people are busier than ever and struggle to find the time to prepare balanced and nutritious meals for themselves. That's why we offer a uniquely natural, science-enhanced range of plant-based powders that can be mixed with anything, making it easier than ever to improve your nutrition. 


• Product description:

Say hello to a healthier you with ElevenLabs Plant Protein & Super Greens! This isn't your average protein powder or health food - it's your 100% natural plant-based supplement that's jam-packed with essential nutrients from real food ingredients to help you achieve optimal wellness.

Our premium formula is carefully crafted with the most nutrient-dense ingredients available, and just 100g of our product contains the equivalent to 2kg of fresh veggies like broccoli and spinach! That's a powerful nutritional boost that can make a huge difference in your day, all in a simple and easy way.

• USP (Unique Selling Point):

Experience the difference with ElevenLabs. Our scientifically-formulated, award-winning proprietary formula uses only the highest-quality, plant-based ingredients, without any gluten, dairy, sugar, or artificial sweeteners or stevia. We never use fillers or other additives, ensuring that every tablespoon provides the maximum nutritional value possible.

Each batch is lovingly crafted in small quantities, right here in Australia, to ensure the utmost quality. And, as a female-founded company, we're passionate about providing you with the most convenient and effective way to boost your health and wellness!

 
• Payment terms:

Our Affiliate program will detect each click generated by your affiliate ID and store a cookie in the visitor's computer. If the visitor makes a purchase within 30 days of the first click, you'll get 10% of the sales revenue (excluding shipping, tax and discounts) Affiliates who generate sales above $1000 AUD per month are entitled to a further 2.5% commission on sales (maximum 12.5%). We keep track of the most recent clicks and you can see them on your own affiliate area (it's an easy way to make sure the link you added on your website is working properly). If a conversion originated from the same IP-address as the affiliate, the sale will not be approved. 

Payments will be made after 30 days on the 1st of every month however if it falls on a weekend or public holiday, payments will be made on the next business day. You will be paid in Australian Dollars (AUD).
